slides.title: Night attacks hit rural farming families
reported killed in Shirka Woreda, Arsi
slides.body: Local families told Borkena Orthodox Christian households in three kebeles were attacked at night and homes burned. Not independently verified.

slides.title: No official statement yet
slides.body: Residents of Gobesa reportedly begged police to intervene. Borkena said no government statement had been issued. The attackers have not been identified.

slides.title: farmers killed on the Oromia border
slides.body: In Burji and Kore zones (South Ethiopia), with 200+ livestock looted. A local police commander blamed armed men from West Guji.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate every attack.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
